insights.title: TCS alone is 34% of the sector
insights.detail: The top three companies hold 68% of combined market value. Value behaves as if spread across 5.3 equal-sized companies, not 10 - a cap-weighted IT index is a concentrated bet.

insights.title: OFSS is growing fastest at 68.7% YoY
insights.detail: Median revenue growth across the group is 17.6%; Wipro is slowest at 10.6%.

insights.title: OFSS has the widest operating margin (49.7%)
insights.detail: Industry median is 15.8%, or 21.3% weighted by market cap.

insights.title: Persistent trades at 42.3× earnings vs. a 21.9× median
insights.detail: The cheapest on trailing earnings is Wipro at 12.5×.

insights.title: An equal-weight basket cuts volatility by 21%
insights.detail: Average pairwise return correlation is 0.59; the least correlated pair is HCLTech and OFSS (0.27). Stocks in one industry share the same demand cycle, so diversification within it has a ceiling.

insights.title: Coforge is the most volatile (39% annualised)
insights.detail: Its deepest 1-year drawdown was -46%; the industry median volatility is 30%.

insights.title: 10 of 10 companies pass every cross-check
insights.detail: Quarterly filings were reconciled with each annual report, EPS with profit ÷ shares, and prices with NSE's end-of-day file. No figure disagreed beyond tolerance.
